description: Root cause: `omp auth-gateway stdio` builds its served catalog from chat models only, so `/v1/systemone` and `/alpha/decisions` answer 404 for every judge model. Reproduced on omp 18.9.1 and 18.12.3; no env var, config key or model id changes it. The 594 judgments in the host judgment cache came from omp's in-process judge role, which still works. Fix in the oracle cutover: `jev.py` now POSTs directly to `https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone` with `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, which the select-1 job already holds. Verified with a live call returning answers. Remaining upstream issue: the omp gateway should serve judge-kind models.
